sessions.phase_label: As-built review negotiation and additional permit-package scoping
Nevada concurrence method selection and document preparation
Stamped deliverable correction and schematic-callout follow-up

requirements.title: Limited Electrical As-Built Review
requirements.definition: Review and provide electrical concurrence for only the identified minor modifications rather than reviewing or redesigning the full drawing set.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the substantive review of the identified modifications; the evidence used for verification and the form of the stamped deliverable can change independently and are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Documentation Supporting Change Verification
requirements.definition: Provide sufficient documentation of the modified areas, such as the written scope, photographs, room identifiers, and location markups, so the completed work can be checked against the described changes.
requirements.boundary_note: The individual document types are parameters of one evidence-basis mechanism, not separate Requirements; this excludes the independently evolving choice of stamped output format.

requirements.title: PE-Stamped Electrical Concurrence Package
requirements.definition: Deliver a signed and PE-stamped artifact confirming concurrence with the electrical changes, using an approved presentation method such as a cover letter with the change file or stamped marked-up electrical sheets.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the stamped concurrence artifact and its selected delivery method; correct PE identity, document date formatting, and later schematic callouts have independently testable acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Correct Nevada Electrical PE Identity and Attribution
requirements.definition: Use and accurately identify the appropriate Nevada electrical PE, including the correct license information and full legal name in the stamped deliverable's signature block.
requirements.boundary_note: The PE name, license number, and rendered legal-name attribution are attributes of one certification-identity mechanism; whether the artifact is stamped at all remains part of the concurrence-package Requirement.

requirements.title: US-Formatted Concurrence Document Date
requirements.definition: Render the date on the concurrence deliverable in the required US month/day/year format.
requirements.boundary_note: Date formatting can be corrected and accepted independently of the PE identity, stamp presence, and substantive concurrence wording.

requirements.title: Stamped Electrical Schematic Callouts
requirements.definition: Apply the electrical PE stamp to schematic-sheet callouts that restate the previously approved original-scope electrical changes in greater detail.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a subsequent independently deliverable set of stamped schematic callouts, not merely another formatting attribute of the already accepted stamped note.

requirements.title: Permit-Ready Electrical Drawing Package
requirements.definition: Create permit-ready electrical drawings and provide the required electrical PE stamp for the separately discussed permit-design project.
requirements.boundary_note: Drawing production and stamping form one electrical permit-package deliverable; electrical calculations and HVAC Manual J/S/D calculations have separate technical outputs and can change independently.

requirements.title: Required Electrical Design Calculations
requirements.definition: Perform the electrical calculations required to support production and permitting of the electrical drawings.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers electrical calculations only; Manual J, Manual S, and Manual D are HVAC-oriented calculation methods with a separate acceptance basis.

requirements.title: Manual J, S, and D Calculations
requirements.definition: Provide the applicable Manual J, Manual S, and Manual D calculations, including the required HVAC sizing analysis, while excluding Title 24 work where stated.
requirements.boundary_note: Manual J, S, and D are retained as attributes of one coordinated HVAC calculation package; the statement that Title 24 is not required is a scope attribute rather than a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: California Electrical PE Credential
requirements.definition: Identify an electrical PE with the appropriate California license for the separately discussed permit-design work.
requirements.boundary_note: The professional's jurisdictional credential can change independently of the drawing and calculation content; the later retraction of license number 47283 requires lifecycle-level treatment rather than merging this with Nevada attribution.

unresolved_candidates.description: The additional project clearly mentions permit-ready mechanical and plumbing drawings, but the supplied history does not safely resolve whether the freelancer was responsible for creating those drawings or only for the electrical package and calculations.

License number 47283 is first supplied after a request for a California electrical PE credential but is later discussed as a Nevada license and disclaimed by the freelancer; Event extraction should preserve the jurisdiction and identity conflict without transferring the replacement Nevada credential to the California Requirement.
